export_visualization: export a grid image of GAN generations to a file path with optional mask export
export_db: export a dataset of fake GAN generations as individual image files to a directory
generate_images_from_constraints: generate images from label constraints like gender and color and save or publish them
save_interpolation: save interpolated images between two latent vectors as a sequence of output files
export_nn: compute the nearest neighbors metric for GAN generations using a feature extractor and KDTree
